scenes: Air conditioning may have prevented three hundred and sixty thousand deaths a year.
But in the poorest countries, only about three in every hundred households have it. | That’s the cooling gap.
Close it with shade, cool roofs and efficient fans first, | because cooling now drives a growing share of energy emissions.
Cool for everyone, without heating the planet.
